WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_quantity, ss_list_price, ss_coupon_amt, ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_cdemo_sk IN (
            SELECT cd_demo_sk
            FROM customer_demographics
            WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
              AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
              AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
        )
      AND ss_sold_date_sk IN (
            SELECT d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim
            WHERE d_year = 1999
        )
      AND ss_store_sk IN (
            SELECT s_store_sk
            FROM store
            WHERE s_state = 'TN'
        )
),
item_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           COUNT(f.ss_quantity) AS cnt_ss_quantity,
           SUM(f.ss_quantity) AS sum_ss_quantity,
           COUNT(f.ss_list_price) AS cnt_ss_list_price,
           SUM(f.ss_list_price) AS sum_ss_list_price,
           COUNT(f.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_ss_coupon_amt,
           SUM(f.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_ss_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(f.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_ss_sales_price,
           SUM(f.ss_sales_price) AS sum_ss_sales_price
    FROM filtered_sales f
    JOIN item i ON f.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT i_item_id, 'TN'::text AS s_state, 0 AS g_state,
       sum_ss_quantity::numeric / cnt_ss_quantity AS agg1,
       sum_ss_list_price::numeric / cnt_ss_list_price AS agg2,
       sum_ss_coupon_amt::numeric / cnt_ss_coupon_amt AS agg3,
       sum_ss_sales_price::numeric / cnt_ss_sales_price AS agg4
FROM item_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT i_item_id, NULL::text, 1,
       sum_ss_quantity::numeric / cnt_ss_quantity,
       sum_ss_list_price::numeric / cnt_ss_list_price,
       sum_ss_coupon_amt::numeric / cnt_ss_coupon_amt,
       sum_ss_sales_price::numeric / cnt_ss_sales_price
FROM item_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL::text, 1,
       SUM(sum_ss_quantity)::numeric / SUM(cnt_ss_quantity),
       SUM(sum_ss_list_price)::numeric / SUM(cnt_ss_list_price),
       SUM(sum_ss_coupon_amt)::numeric / SUM(cnt_ss_coupon_amt),
       SUM(sum_ss_sales_price)::numeric / SUM(cnt_ss_sales_price)
FROM item_agg
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
